info.sub_name: 企業家精神與經濟發展

description.sub_name: 企業家精神與經濟發展
description.describe_ch: 本課程回顧經濟學裡的企業家理論，介紹奧地利學派的創業過程；並應用企業家理論分析經濟發展的相關問題，包括中小企業、創見、政府、國貿與轉型經濟等
description.describe_eh: This course reviews theories of entrepreneurship in economics and introduces Austrian theories of the entrepreneurial process. It also applies the theories of entrepreneurship to understand issues in economic development, including small family business, innovation, government, trade, transition economies, institutional change and catching up in the world development process. The course will make special references to Taiwan and other Asian Pacific economies
